rita (sec): Heads-up: Some customers reported SCIM deprovision 403s after yesterday's RBAC cleanup. Opening thread for quick triage.
omar (idp): looking. initial log snippet:
```
2026-05-11T01:03:12Z identity ERROR scim deprov extid=mariner|U-77 -> 403
2026-05-11T01:03:12Z identity WARN kms unwrap failed: DecryptionError: encryption_context_mismatch expected={"role_sig":"sig_v1"} got={"role_sig":"sig_normalized"}
```
kevin (sre): how many tenants/requests? any customer impact beyond stalling deprovision queue?
omar (idp): small blast: 6 stuck deprovs across mariner & pebblecorp in the last 90m. No outage but deprovision not completing, ticket pile-up.
rita (sec): compliance needs audit trail & counts. please record RBAC migration tx id.
omar (idp): RBAC job shows tx=rbac-20260510-8 and we changed how we generate role_sig (we started unicode-normalizing names). That changed the value included in the KMS envelope.
kevin (sre): safe remediation: targeted rewrap/backfill for affected extids. dry-run first. Can we add pause-on-error?
omar (idp): yes. dry-run command: `./scripts/identity_rewrap --tenant mariner --dry-run --limit 100` found 8 candidates. Rewrap command: `./scripts/identity_rewrap --tenant mariner --batch 25` (will pause if error_rate>5%).
cli-bot: queued job identity-rewrap-runner for tenant=mariner at 2026-05-11T02:20:00Z
okms-bot: key-check: no KMS key rotation between 2026-05-10T22:00 and 2026-05-11T02:00. Context-only mismatch.
kevin (sre): canary finished: 8 objects rewrapped, 0 failures. SCIM queue retried, deprovs completed for mariner.
omar (idp): filing tech-debt: IDP-2140 "omit mutable role_sig from KMS context; use immutable role_id instead". Will include migration plan + runbook for rewrap.
rita (sec): add audit entry lines and attach to compliance ticket. sample audit lines to capture:
```
2026-05-11T01:02:59Z audit INFO actor=rbac service=rbac action=normalize_roles tx=rbac-20260510-8
2026-05-11T02:21:05Z audit INFO actor=idp service=identity action=rewrap batch=25 tenant=mariner tx=idp-rewrap-2140
```
kevin (sre): adding reversible guard to job that pauses on >5% errors and tombstones changes to allow easy rollback.
rita (sec): good. include compliance sign-off before broad roll. We'll also recommend a pre-change detection: if future RBAC builds change role signatures, run a prediction dry-run to estimate rewrap candidates.
omar (idp): agreed. I'll update runbook and schedule IDP-2140 planning.
kevin (sre): closing the immediate incident. will keep this thread for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
